# pulse_stream (Data Source)

Reads any stream, including the managed `EVENTS` stream, for example to use its subjects or limits.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pulse_stream" "events" {
  name = "EVENTS"
}

output "events_max_bytes" {
  value = data.pulse_stream.events.max_bytes
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Stream name, e.g. `EVENTS`.

### Read-Only

- `allow_direct` (Boolean) Direct get allowed.
- `compression` (Boolean) S2 compression.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `discard` (String) `old` or `new`.
- `duplicates_seconds` (Number) De-duplication window in seconds.
- `kind` (String) `stream`, `kv` (a KV bucket's stream) or `object` (an object store's stream).
- `managed` (Boolean) Owned by pulsed (cannot be managed with `pulse_stream`).
- `max_age_seconds` (Number) Maximum age in seconds (0 = none).
- `max_bytes` (Number) Size limit (-1 = unlimited).
- `max_msg_size` (Number) Largest message (-1 = unlimited).
- `max_msgs` (Number) Message count limit (-1 = unlimited).
- `storage` (String) `file` or `memory`.
- `subjects` (Set of String) Subjects.
